name: Create All Tables
func:
const tables = [
    // Machine Daily History
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS machine_daily_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        ts_text TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        uid TEXT,
        action TEXT,
        response_time TEXT,
        repair_time TEXT
    )`,
    // Machine Weekly History
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS machine_weekly_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
        ts_text TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT,
        name TEXT,
        uid TEXT,
        action TEXT,
        response_time TEXT,
        repair_time TEXT
    )`,
    // Technicians
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS technicians (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        total INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        failures INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        escalations INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )`,
    // Interventions
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interventions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        machine TEXT,
        technician TEXT,
        technician_name TEXT,
        time DATETIME,
        status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',
        source TEXT
    )`,
    // Machine State
    `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS machine_state (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        state TEXT DEFAULT 'RUNNING',
        state_duration INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        last_update DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        active_intervention_id TEXT,
        location TEXT
    )`
];

// Insert sample technicians
const insertTechs = `
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO technicians (id, name, total, failures, escalations) VALUES 
    ('37EECE86', 'Ahmed', 45, 2, 1),
    ('4711CFB6', 'Aziz', 30, 5, 2),
    ('D455D886', 'Chef Ligne', 60, 0, 0),
    ('86EC12BF', 'Chef Atelier', 25, 1, 0)
`;

// Insert initial machine state
const insertMachine = `
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO machine_state (id, name, state, location) VALUES 
    ('M1', 'Machine M1', 'RUNNING', 'factory/line1')
`;

return [
    ...tables.map(sql => ({ topic: sql, payload: [] })),
    { topic: insertTechs, payload: [] },
    { topic: insertMachine, payload: [] }
];

sqlquery:
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN state='FAILURE' THEN 1 END) as failures,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN action='maintenance_end' OR state='RUNNING' THEN 1 END) as repairs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN state='ESCALATION' THEN 1 END) as escalations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN action='maintenance_start' THEN 1 END) as maintenance,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN state='CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) as critical
FROM machine_daily_history
WHERE ts > (strftime('%s', 'now', '-1 day') * 1000)
